title_sq: Tek Ali Demi, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim!!
description_sq: Ne Ali Dem, ne Rrugen Idriz Dollaku, Shitet Apartament 1+1 ne Ndertim Te Ri!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te banimit, ne nje godine banimi dhe sherbimi 5,6,7,8 dhe 9 kate dhe me 2 kate parkimi nentoke. Apartamenti ka orientim Perendim. Ka siperfaqe bruto 70m², siperfaqe neto 59 m². Apartamenti organizohet si me poshte: korridori shperndares, salloni ku ndodhet ambienti i ndenjes dhe kendi gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dhome gjumi matrimoniale, dhe tualeti. Materialet qe po perdoren dhe teknologjite e reja te ndertimit, si ne realizimin e rifiniturave ashtu edhe ne realizimin e shtresave hidro-izoluese, realizimin e murit dopio qe ndan apartamentet midis tyre dhe me ambientin e jashtem, izolim akustik, pajisjet hidraulike te markave cilesore, vetratat cilesore, sistemi i kondicionimit multisplit bejne qe cilesia e ndertimit te jete maksimale. Ndertimi aktualisht eshte ne faze suvatimesh.
title_en: At Ali Demi, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!
description_en: In Ali Dem, on Idriz Dollaku street, 1+1 apartment for sale in a new building!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of the residence, in a residential and service building with 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 floors and with 2 floors of underground parking. The apartment has a West orientation. It has a gross area of ​​70 m², a net area of ​​59 m². The apartment is organized as follows: distribution corridor, living room where there is a living room and a kitchen with access to the balcony, a matrimonial bedroom, and a toilet. The materials that are being used and new construction technologies, both in the realization of refinishing and in the realization of hydro-insulating layers, the realization of the double wall that separates the apartments between them and the external environment, acoustic insulation, hydraulic equipment of quality brands, quality windows, the multisplit air conditioning system make the quality of the construction to be maximum. The building is currently in the plastering stage.
